title: Install CLINK Sensor Wiring for Z-Axis (I/O1/DI6/DI7) and A-Axis (PCA) and Restart Operator Station
summary: Install the CLINK sensor wiring by feeding the sensor through the rear wire routing hole and fastening it with an M3 button-head screw, routing Z-axis wires through the column and out the lower grommet into the control box (I/O1, DI6, or DI7), routing A-axis wires around the gearbox into the PCA, then restarting the operator station so the sensor connections are active.
when_to_use: Use when CLINK sensor wiring for the Z-axis and A-axis needs to be installed/reconnected so the sensor connections are active after wiring work.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the physical wiring installation steps (sensor fastening, wire routing, and connector plugging) and restart the operator station.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the sensor rear side and wire routing hole
Access to the control box ports (I/O1, DI6, DI7)
Access to the PCA connector for A-axis wiring
Operator station restart capability (per "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66)

external_references: Manual section reference: "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66 (restart procedure referenced by this installation section)

visual_references.description: Figure 7-2: Z-Axis CLINK Connections (rear wire routing hole, column path, lower grommet exit, and control box ports I/O1, DI6, DI7).
Figure 7-3: A-Axis PCA Connections (A-axis wire routing around the gearbox into the PCA).

steps.title: Feed the sensor through the rear wire routing hole and fasten with the M3 button-head screw
steps.purpose: Mechanically secure the CLINK sensor and prepare it for correct wire routing.
steps.instruction: Feed the sensor through the wire routing hole on the rear side and fasten it in place using the M3 button-head screw.
steps.expected_result: The sensor is mechanically fastened at the rear wire routing hole using the M3 button-head screw.
steps.healthy_condition: The sensor is secured with the M3 button-head screw at the rear wire routing hole (no loose mounting).
steps.failure_condition: The sensor is not secured (e.g., screw not installed/loose) or not seated at the rear wire routing hole.

actions.label: Fasten CLINK sensor
actions.exact_action: Feed the sensor through the wire routing hole on the rear side and fasten in place using the M3 button-head screw.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.2.1.2 INSTALLATION: "Feed the sensor through the wire routing hole on the rear side and fasten in place using the M3 button-head screw."

steps.title: Route Z-axis wires through the column and out the lower grommet into the control box (I/O1, DI6, or DI7)
steps.purpose: Ensure the Z-axis CLINK wiring reaches the correct control box inputs.
steps.instruction: Route the Z-axis wires by dropping them down through the column and out the lower grommet into the control box, then plug into either I/O1, DI6, or DI7.
steps.expected_result: Z-axis wiring exits via the lower grommet into the control box and is connected to one of I/O1, DI6, or DI7.
steps.healthy_condition: Z-axis wires follow the column path and terminate at a control box port labeled I/O1, DI6, or DI7.
steps.failure_condition: Z-axis wires do not exit through the lower grommet into the control box, or they are not plugged into I/O1, DI6, or DI7.

actions.label: Verify Z-axis wire exit and port
actions.exact_action: Route the wire: Z-axis wires drop down through the column and out the lower grommet into the control box and plug into either I/O1, DI6, or DI7.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check wiring routing if the Z-axis wires are not exiting through the lower grommet into the control box or if they are not plugged into I/O1, DI6, or DI7.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.2.1.2 INSTALLATION: "Route the wire: Z-axis wires drop down through the column and out the lower grommet into the control box and plug into either I/O1, DI6, or DI7."

steps.title: Route A-axis wires around the gearbox and plug into the PCA
steps.purpose: Ensure the A-axis CLINK wiring reaches the correct PCA connector.
steps.instruction: Route the A-axis wires around the gearbox and plug them into the PCA.
steps.expected_result: A-axis wiring is routed around the gearbox and connected to the PCA.
steps.healthy_condition: A-axis wires follow the gearbox routing path and terminate at the PCA connector.
steps.failure_condition: A-axis wires are not routed around the gearbox or are not plugged into the PCA.

actions.label: Verify A-axis wire routing and PCA connection
actions.exact_action: Route the wire: A-axis wires route around the gearbox and plug into the PCA.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check wiring routing if the A-axis wires are not routed around the gearbox or are not plugged into the PCA.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.2.1.2 INSTALLATION: "Route the wire: A-axis wires route around the gearbox and plug into the PCA."

steps.title: Restart the operator station
steps.purpose: Activate the sensor connections after wiring installation.
steps.instruction: Restart the operator station using the procedure referenced as "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66.
steps.expected_result: The operator station has been restarted.
steps.healthy_condition: Operator station restart completes successfully (per the referenced restart procedure on page 66).
steps.failure_condition: Operator station restart does not complete successfully.

actions.label: Restart operator station
actions.exact_action: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the operator station restart does not complete successfully, escalate to support and use the operator-station restart troubleshooting guidance (not included in this section).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.2.1.2 INSTALLATION step 3: "Re-start the operator station (see \"Starting The Operator Station\" on page 66)."

success_criteria: Sensor is mechanically fastened with the M3 button-head screw.
Z-axis wiring exits via the lower grommet into the control box and is connected to I/O1, DI6, or DI7.
A-axis wiring is routed around the gearbox and connected to the PCA.
healthy_conditions: Z-axis wires are routed down through the column and out the lower grommet into the control box, plugged into I/O1, DI6, or DI7.
A-axis wires are routed around the gearbox and plugged into the PCA.
failure_conditions: Z-axis wires are not exiting through the lower grommet into the control box, or are not plugged into I/O1, DI6, or DI7.
A-axis wires are not routed around the gearbox, or are not plugged into the PCA.
Operator station restart does not complete successfully.
escalation_guidance: If the operator station restart does not complete successfully, escalate to support and use the operator-station restart troubleshooting guidance (not included in this section).

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.2.1.2 Installation steps: feed sensor through rear wire routing hole and fasten with M3 button-head screw; route Z-axis wires through column and out lower grommet into control box and plug into I/O1, DI6, or DI7; route A-axis wires around gearbox and plug into PCA; restart operator station.
Figure 7-3 A-Axis PCA Connections supports the A-axis wiring routing around the gearbox into the PCA.
